files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+[test]
+coverage = true
+coverageReporter = ["text", "lcov"]
+coverageDir = "coverage"
+coverageSkipTestFiles = true
+randomize = true
+rerunEach = 2
+timeout = 20000
+
+[test.coverageThreshold]
+line = { per_file = 0.80, summary = 0.95 }
+function = { per_file = 0.80, summary = 0.95 }
+statement = { per_file = 0.80, summary = 0.95 }
+branch = { per_file = 0.80, summary = 0.95 }

@@ -6,6 +6,21 @@ coverageSkipTestFiles = true
 randomize = true
 rerunEach = 2
 timeout = 20000
+# Keep raw `bun test` aligned with `make test` by defaulting discovery to
+# unit-test directories only. Full-suite commands use bunfig.full.toml.
+pathIgnorePatterns = [
+	"tests/bundle/**",
+	"tests/cli/**",
+	"tests/config/**",
+	"tests/contracts/**",
+	"tests/manifest/**",
+	"tests/mcp/**",
+	"tests/notes/**",
+	"tests/planning/**",
+	"tests/repomix/**",
+	"tests/shared/**",
+	"tests/vcs/**",
+]
 
 [test.coverageThreshold]
 line = { per_file = 0.80, summary = 0.95 }

@@ -31,13 +31,13 @@
     "lint": "biome check . && node scripts/check-boundaries.js",
     "check-boundaries": "node scripts/check-boundaries.js",
     "test:unit": "bun test --coverage tests/unit --timeout 20000",
-    "test:integration": "bun test --coverage tests/cli tests/bundle --timeout 20000",
+    "test:integration": "bun --config=bunfig.full.toml test --coverage tests/cli tests/bundle --timeout 20000",
     "test": "bun run test:unit",
     "release": "node scripts/release.js",
     "gen:homebrew": "node scripts/generate-homebrew-formula.js",
     "check": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json",
     "fix": "biome check --write --unsafe .",
-    "verify": "bun run lint && bun run check && bun run build && bun test --coverage tests --timeout 20000 && node scripts/coverage-summary.js",
+    "verify": "bun run lint && bun run check && bun run build && bun --config=bunfig.full.toml test --coverage tests --timeout 20000 && node scripts/coverage-summary.js",
     "copy:init": "node scripts/copy-init-templates.js",
     "notes": "cx notes list && cx notes orphans",
     "smoke": "node scripts/repomix-version-smoke.js",
